## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix the `--json` path handling before merge: `--json` takes the next argument as its path even when that argument is another flag, so `--json` with no path breaks when `--junit` comes after it, which is the combination the PR description advertises.

## Changes
The pull request adds a `--json` option to `parse_args` in `app/cli.py`, with `results.json` as the default path. It also adds a `write_reports` helper that writes each parsed report to its path, and new tests in `tests/test_cli.py`.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cli.py:15 — correctness — Don't take a following flag as the `--json` path — The input `["--json", "--junit", "a.xml"]` sets `json` to `"--junit"` and then raises `ValueError("unknown option: a.xml")`, because line 15 only checks `i + 1 < len(args)`. The `--junit` branch rejects arguments that start with `--`, but this one does not. — Users who put a bare `--json` before `--junit` get a confusing error, and `write_reports` never writes either report. — Fix: Use the same `args[i + 1].startswith("--")` check as line 7 for both the destination assignment and the index increment, and extend `test_json_default_and_explicit_path` with `["--json", "--junit", "a.xml"]`.
